scope: Readback of native final exports against carrier/design.json; no CAD edits or bench validation
notes: Final release export readback confirms 42 components and 137 electrical pins match carrier/design.json and both native netlists. PCB contains one additional un-numbered/net-null USB mechanical pad entry.
Five single-pin reserve nets are AUX, BOOT0, NRST, SWCLK and SWDIO; schematic API returns warn=5.
One USB mechanical NPTH info was observed in native UI by the parent agent; it is consistent with the extra mechanical PCB-netlist entry.
U13 footprint 91885815ee8159ca pad2 is GND with connectMode DIRECT in the final native epro2.
Final archive mechanical-page n9 and the PDF both contain D90; prior stale D10 note is resolved.
No claim that native Gerbers equal KiCad Gerbers, or that analog performance has been bench validated.
